name: GDGC DYPCOE
bio: Empowering tech enthusiasts at DYPCOE — fostering innovation & learning. (Official Google Developer Groups on Campus chapter)
collegeName: D Y Patil College of Engineering, Akurdi
description: Google Developer Groups on Campus (GDGC) DYPCOE is a community group for students interested in Google developer technologies. Students from all undergraduate or graduate programs with an interest in growing as a developer are welcome. By joining a GDG On Campus, students grow their knowledge in a peer-to-peer learning environment and build solutions for local businesses and their community.
achievements: Best Tech Event of the Year 2023

name: ITESA DYPCOE
bio: Create | Explore | Commit. IT department's student association.
collegeName: D Y Patil College of Engineering, Akurdi
description: Information Technology Engineering Student Association (ITESA) is a student chapter committed to creating an environment for IT students to explore and commit to technological advancement. We organize workshops, seminars, and hackathons.

name: ACES DYPCOE
bio: Association of Computer Engineering Students. Promoting open-source and computer science excellence.
